title: Viva Connections - Simply Explained
description:
Static intranets are a ghost town, and many employees never find the news, tools and policies they need. This episode explains Viva Connections and its 2026 rename to SharePoint for intranet owners, internal communicators and Microsoft 365 admins. You learn its three components, the engagement stats that matter and the first steps to make it work.
In this episode
00:00 – Intro: a renamed employee tool00:24 – The old intranet problem01:50 – What Viva Connections is03:12 – The 2026 rebrand to SharePoint05:03 – Component 1: The news reader06:54 – Components 2 and 3: Dashboard and resources10:41 – The engagement stats that matter12:45 – Who needs it and first steps
Key takeaways
Viva Connections is an employee experience front door inside Teams, built on a SharePoint home site, with a news reader, a dashboard of cards and curated resources.In 2026 Microsoft renamed the Viva Connections app in Teams to the SharePoint app, while functionality and admin tools stayed the same and the basic version remains included in Microsoft 365.Adoption depends on pinning the app globally in Teams, keeping news fresh with multiple posts per week and offering a rich dashboard, especially for mobile and frontline workers.
Worth quoting
“Viva connections is an employee experience app that lives inside Microsoft Teams. And you can think of it as a digital front door. One place where employees go for company news, tools, and resources.” – Mirko Peters (01:54)
“Viva Connections was always powered by SharePoint. The news, the dashboard, the resources, all of it came from a SharePoint home site behind the scenes” – Mirko Peters (03:31)
